blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了CrownFusion,一种潜在的扩散模型,从几何图像中生成3D的牙冠设计,一种表面坐标的2D格编码. 脱离使用点云的传统方法,我们的"CrownImage"代表不仅解锁了基于图像的基因架构的全部功率,而且通过在远高于点云的空间分辨率操作来保存精细的几何细节,以缓解3D代的平滑文物. 我们的概率扩散模型以共同学习的周围凹陷嵌入为条件,产生了解剖学上可行的冠冕,其形态变化适合个别病人的情况。 为了适应多种有效的设计,我们提出一个基于靠近对角齿的闭合度量度. 我们通过涉及专家证词的定量实验和定性研究来评估我们的方法。 我们还发布了外国直接投资16 Crown数据集,其中包括11 513个附加说明的口腔扫描,以支持今后在牙科CAD方面的研究。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Computer-aided dental design software has streamlined the creation of artificial tooth replacements, allowing technicians to adapt templates to individual patients. Yet, crown design remains labor-intensive, requiring precise adaptation to each patient’s unique dental morphology. A clinically acceptable crown must achieve adequate occlusal fit with the opposing dentition,
maintain functional contact without hyperocclusion [ 3 ] , and reflect natural tooth morphology, including well-defined occlusal grooves that direct food flow during mastication.
In practice however, there is no single correct crown for a given case. Multiple clinically acceptable designs may exist, shaped by the technician’s training, experience, and aesthetic judgement [ 19 , 13 ] .
This motivates a generative approach to capture a space of clinically acceptable solutions rather than predicting a single outcome, as well as developing a suitable metric for evaluation.
blocks.zh:
计算机辅助的牙科设计软件简化了人工取牙的创建,使技术人员能够将模板适应个别患者. 然而,皇冠设计仍然是劳动密集型的,需要准确适应每个患者独特的牙科形态。 在临床上可以接受的冠必须达到与相抗的凹痕相适应的足够隐蔽性,
保持功能接触,不发生高分泌[3],并反映自然牙齿形态,包括定义明确的分泌地沟,在分泌过程中引导食物流动.
但在实践中,特定案件没有单一正确的冠冕. 根据技术员的培训、经验和审美判断,可能存在多种临床上可接受的设计[19、13]。
这促使人们采取遗传性办法,抓住临床上可接受的解决办法的空间,而不是预测单一的结果,并制订适当的评价尺度。

blocks.en:
In terms of shape representations, previous approaches to automated dental crown design face fundamental limitations.
Point cloud-based methods [ 23 , 7 , 20 ] frame crown design as a shape completion task, requiring a separate mesh extraction step that typically introduces surface artifacts. They tend to produce overly smooth outputs and erode clinically important details such as sharp fissures, due to the difficulty of placing points at high-curvature features and optimization using
the Chamfer Distance [ 1 ] (CD), which is insensitive to local geometric details.
Depth image-based methods [ 8 , 27 , 19 ] are confined to projection from a single viewpoint, inherently discarding 3D information.
For instance, the lingual surface of an antagonist tooth, which directly contacts the generated crown during occlusion, may be entirely occluded and absent from the depth rendering.
blocks.zh:
在外形表现方面,以往自动化牙冠设计的方法面临根本性的限制.
点云法 [23, 7, 20] 相框花冠设计作为外形完成任务,需要单独的网状提取步骤,通常引入地表文物. 它们往往产生过于平滑的输出,并侵蚀尖锐裂缝等临床上重要的细节,因为很难在高曲率地段设置出点并使用最优化
Chamfer 距离 [1] (CD), 对本地几何细节不敏感 。
基于深度图像的方法[8, 27, 19] 限于从单一角度投影,内在抛弃了3D信息.
例如,在被隔离期间直接接触所生成的王冠的对角牙齿的语言表面可能完全被渗透,并且没有深度渲染。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview. From left to right: (1) Input: prepared tooth (bronze) and surrounding dentition (gray) from an intraoral scan. (2) Baseline: point cloud-based methods with Poisson reconstruction yield overly smooth geometry eroding occlusal detail. (3) Ours: a diffusion transformer generates a geometry image encoding of the crown surface, which is then meshed to recover the 3D crown, preserving fine occlusal features.
blocks.zh: 图1:概览。 从左到右: (1)输入:从内侧扫描得到准备的牙齿(铜)和周围凹痕(灰色). (2) 基线:以点云为基础的方法与Poisson重建产生过于平滑的几何来侵蚀隐形细节。 (3)我们的:扩散变压器产生花冠表面的几何图像编码,然后被套取来取回3D花冠,保存了精细的封口特征.

blocks.en:
In this work, we address these limitations by generating 3D dental crowns through geometry images [ 6 ] , which encode a tooth’s surface geometry into a 2D grid, i.e., a CrownImage , with each entry storing an [ x , y , z ] [x,y,z] coordinate on the surface as color
( Fig. 2 ).
Such a 3D-to-2D mapping is facilitated by the reliable manifold topology of tooth meshes, ensuring a seamless parameterization onto the 2D grid. Unlike single-view depth renderings, geometry images retain full 3D geometric information, while supporting far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to better preserve fine-grained and high-curvature teeth features.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们通过几何图像生成3D牙冠来解决这些局限性,这些图像将牙齿的表面几何编码为2D网格,即CrownImage,每个条目将一个[x,y,z] [x,y,z]坐标存储在表面,作为颜色.
(图2).
这种从3D到2D的绘图利用了可靠的多面地貌来进行,确保了2D网格上的无缝参数化。 与单视深度渲染不同,几何图像保留了完整的3D几何信息,同时支持远高于点云的空间分辨率来更好地保存精细和高曲率的牙齿特征.

blocks.en: CrownImages, our image-based teeth representation, enables us to develop CrownFusion , a conditional latent diffusion model for 3D crown generation. To our knowledge, this is both the first use of geometry images and the first latent diffusion model for this task. We combine the Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) [ 11 ] and a FLUX VAE [ 2 ] , with cross-attention conditioning on shape embeddings of the surrounding dentition ( Fig. 1 ). The generation of multiple morphologically varied crown candidates for a single patient offers clinicians a range of viable designs to explore. To complement standard CD evaluation, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth to better capture functional performance. Experiments show that CrownFusion achieves competitive occlusal alignment with existing completion-based methods while producing substantially fewer intersections. Expert testimonials confirm that our method consistently produces more well-defined and natural-looking occlusal anatomy and was less prone to blunt or anatomically incoherent surfaces than baselines. Finally, we release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset of 11,513 annotated intraoral scans.
blocks.zh: CrownImages,我们基于图像的牙齿代表, 使我们能够开发CrownFusion, 一个有条件的潜在扩散模型 3D王冠生成。 据我们所知,这既是几何图像的首次使用,也是这一任务的第一个潜在传播模型。 我们结合了可伸缩的国际刑警组织变形器(SiT)[11]和一款FLUX VAE [2],在外形嵌入周围凹陷处的相向调节(图一. 为单一患者生成多种形态差异的冠状候选人,为临床医生提供一系列可行的设计来探索. 为了补充裁谈会的标准评价,我们提议根据靠近对抗牙齿的情况,制定一种闭合度指标,以便更好地捕捉功能性能。 实验表明,CrownFusion实现了与以完成为基础的现有方法相竞争的隔离一致,同时产生的交叉点要少得多. 专家证词证实,我们的方法一直产生更明确和自然外观的隐形解剖学,比起基线,较不易发生钝或解剖不一致的表面. 最后,我们公布了11 513个注解的内部扫描的外国直接投资16个王室数据集。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Crown design via 3D completion .
Recent methods frame dental crown generation as a 3D shape completion task. DCrownFormer [ 23 ] and DCrownFormer+ [ 24 ] encode antagonist and preparation tooth point clouds via transformer blocks and a morphology-aware cross-attention decoder.
Similarly, DMC [ 7 ] designs a transformer-based encoder-decoder followed by FoldingNet [ 25 ] to output a point cloud. Recently, VBCD [ 20 ] voxelizes intraoral scans and generates coarse crowns via a 3D UNet followed by point cloud refinement.
Relying on Shape-as-Points [ 14 ] for final mesh extraction, these methods are all deterministic completion approaches with a single outcome per input. In contrast, CrownFusion is fully generative and produces multiple designs based on the surrounding teeth.
blocks.zh:
皇冠设计通过3D完成.
近代方法将牙冠生成作为3D形状完成任务. DCrownFormer [23]和DCrownFormer+ [24]通过变压器块和形态意识交叉分解器来编码对角和制备牙点云.
同样,DMC [7]设计了以变压器为主的编码器-解码器,后被FoldingNet[25]输出出点云. 最近,VBCD[20]通过3D UNet进行口腔内扫描并生成粗冠,再进行点云精炼.
这些方法依靠成形-as-Points [14] 进行最终网格取出,都是确定性的完成方法,每个输入都有一个结果. 相形之下,CrownFusion完全具有基因分泌性,并基于周围的牙齿产生多种设计.

blocks.en:
Crown design via depth image synthesis . Converting dental meshes to depth images is another way to enable the use of 2D deep learning methods. Hwang et al. [ 8 ] applied GANs [ 5 ] to synthesize crown depth images, though results varied in anatomical correctness. Yuan et al. [ 27 ] extended this with a conditional GAN incorporating neighboring teeth and an occlusal groove filter loss to improve fissure alignment. Tian et al. [ 19 ] proposed a dual-GAN framework with global and local discriminators to enforce both contextual consistency and morphological detail. Like CrownFusion, these methods are generative, but they lack the controllable generation afforded by diffusion models.
In addition, generating a complete crown represented by depth images is challenging as it may require generating multiple views that are consistent.
blocks.zh:
Crown设计通过深度图像合成. 将牙科膜转换为深度图像是另一种能够使用2D深层学习方法的方法. 黄等. [8]应用了GANs [5]来合成冠深度图像,虽然结果在解剖正确性上各不相同. 袁等编. [27] 延长了这个条件 加条件的GAN 结合相邻的牙齿 并封口沟道过滤器丢失,以改善裂缝相通性. 天等译. [19] 提出了一个具有全球和地方歧视者的双重全球网络框架,以强化背景一致性和形态细节。 与CrownFusion一样,这些方法具有遗传性,但它们缺乏传播模型所提供的可控制的生成.
此外,制作以深度图像为代表的完整星冠也具有挑战性,因为这可能需要生成一致的多种观点.

blocks.en: Geometry images . Geometry images have primarily been explored for 3D objects with simple topology. Sinha et al. [18] first applied 2D deep learning to geometry images for shape classification, using authalic spherical parameterization to unwrap closed meshes. Maron et al. [12] extended this to toric objects with an additional dimension and stitching to handle topological mismatches. Recently, Yan et al. [22] proposed a latent diffusion pipeline that segments objects into simple patches, maps each to geometry images, and stitches them during reconstruction. In contrast, intraoral scans are open surfaces, inherently compatible with geometry images without complex parameterization or stitching.
blocks.zh: 几何图像 。 几何图像主要为具有简单地貌的3D天体所探索. 辛亥等编. [18]首先将2D深层学习应用到几何图像中来进行形状分类,使用自旋球形参数化来解开闭塞. 马龙等. [12] 将此扩展至带有额外维度并进行缝合的托克对象,以处理地理学错配. 近来. 颜等. [22] 提出了潜在的扩散管,将物体分入简单的补丁,将每个被映射到几何图像,并在重建过程中缝合. 相形之下,内部扫描是开阔的表面,本质上与几何图像相容而无需复杂的参数化或缝合.

blocks.en: 3 Approach
blocks.zh: 3 方针

blocks.en: Our core contribution is the introduction of CrownImages, geometry images [ 6 ] of dental crowns, as a data representation that enables the use of established 2D generative architectures. We train CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model that generates CrownImages conditioned on the surrounding dentition, and contribute the FDI 16 Crown Dataset for training and evaluation. Next, we describe the parameterization, our diffusion pipeline, and the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的核心贡献是引入了Crown Images,几何图像 [6] 牙冠,作为数据代表,能够使用已建立的2D基因架构. 我们培养了CrownFusion,这是一种潜在的传播模式,它产生以周围凹痕为条件的CrownIms,并将FDI 16 Crown Datas集用于培训和评估。 其次,我们描述参数化,我们的传播管道, 和数据集。

blocks.en:
CrownImage construction . We represent the dental crown mesh M M as a 3-channel geometry image 𝐎 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{O}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} , with the 3 channels encoding the spatial coordinates ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) . Figure 2 shows the process via which we obtain the CrownImage 𝐎 \mathbf{O} for a given mesh M M .
Because a tooth is a topological zero-genus surface, we use a global parameterization to encode the tooth with a single chart [ 17 ] .
To construct 𝐎 \mathbf{O} for a given mesh M M , we first flatten M M into a disk M uv M_{\mathrm{uv}} via boundary-fixed harmonic parameterization [ 4 ] .
We then apply a fisheye-style radial transform to obtain M uv ∗ M_{\mathrm{uv}*} so that more space is allocated for the regions closer to the center (corresponding to occlusal surfaces) and less space for the outer rim (containing the axial surfaces).
To obtain 𝐎 \mathbf{O} , we rasterize the
inverse position map π − 1 : 𝒮 → ℝ 3 \pi^{-1}:\mathcal{S}\to\mathbb{R}^{3} onto a regular H × W × 3 H\times W\times 3 grid.
The mesh M ∗ M^{*} is recovered by triangulating adjacent pixels [ 22 ] .

blocks.en: Latent diffusion pipeline . We adopt a latent diffusion framework [ 15 ] to operate on CrownImages ( Fig. 3 ). A variational autoencoder (VAE) encodes the images into latent codes, and a diffusion model generates dental crowns conditioned on the surrounding dentition.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2019-03-21) (英语). Lententt spission pray. 我们采用了潜在传播框架[15],以便在Crown Images上运作(图3)。 一种可变自编码器(VAE)将图像编码为潜在编码,而扩散模型则产生以周围凹陷为条件的牙冠.

blocks.en: For the VAE, we finetune FLUX [ 2 ] . Unlike natural images, CrownImages encode continuous spatial coordinates rather than color values, resulting in a distribution that differs substantially from the data FLUX was pretrained on. Moreover, small latent space errors correspond directly to geometric distortions on the reconstructed surface, making reconstruction fidelity critical. Finetuning the VAE is therefore necessary to faithfully capture geometric variability.
blocks.zh: 对于VAE,我们微调FLUX [2]. 与自然图像不同,CrownImages编码了连续空间坐标,而不是颜色值,导致分布与数据FLUX存在实质性差异,被预先训练. 此外,小的潜在空间误差直接对应了重建地表的几何扭曲,使得重建忠贞性至关重要. 因此,需要微调VAE,以忠实地捕捉几何可变性.

blocks.en: For the diffusion model, we train a Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) [ 11 ] from scratch. The model is conditioned on two complementary inputs: the prepared tooth’s neighbors, the antagonist, and the antagonist’s neighbors, and the margin line of the prepared tooth. The margin line delineates the preparation boundary, anchoring the crown’s seating position and constraining the generated geometry from below. To retain 3D spatial information, we represent the surrounding dentition as a point cloud sampled from the prepared tooth’s neighbors and its antagonist. This context is encoded using a shape encoder [ 29 ] , trained jointly with the diffusion model. The resulting embedding is integrated via cross-attention at each denoising step, providing spatial and morphological cues from surrounding teeth. This enables the model to infer occlusal surface features from the antagonist and cusp and fissure placement from the neighboring teeth. The decoded CrownImage is meshed by triangulating adjacent occupied pixels, i.e. pixels with valid geometric coordinates [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于扩散模型,我们从零开始训练可伸缩的PIONANT变形器(SiT)[11]. 模型以两种补充性投入为条件:准备牙齿的邻居、敌对者、敌对者的邻居以及准备牙齿的边线。 比值线划定了准备分界线,将王冠的座位固定在地上并限制从下方生成的几何. 为了保留3D空间信息,我们代表周围的凹痕,作为从准备的牙齿邻居及其对立者身上取样的点云。 此上下文用外形编码器编码 [29] ,与扩散模型联合训练. 由此产生的嵌入物通过在每一个去诺步骤的交叉注意来进行整合,从周围的牙齿提供空间和形态提示. 这使得模型能够推断出来自相邻牙齿的相对和相克和相克相克的相克地表地表特征。 已解码的CrownImage由相邻被占用的像素三相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接

blocks.en:
FDI 16 crown dataset . To advance dental crown generation research, we release the FDI 16 crown dataset . The dataset comprises 11,513 anonymized intraoral scans collected through the 3Shape Dental System,
with 1,000 scans held out for validation and testing respectively. Each scan is paired with the final crown restoration. We focus on the FDI 16 tooth (upper right first molar) as it is a frequently restored tooth and presents the most complex occlusal morphology of any tooth type, with four to five cusps, an oblique ridge, and a detailed fissure pattern, making it a challenging benchmark. The FDI 16 Tooth Dataset [ 26 ] also includes this tooth, but it only contains isolated natural teeth. Our dataset provides crown restorations paired with surrounding dentition, enabling conditional generation. All scans are centered on the FDI 16 crown with the gingiva removed via segmentation using 3Shape Ortho System 2025.
Where available, the scans include adjacent teeth on the preparation side (FDI 15, 17) and opposing teeth on the antagonist side (FDI 45, 46, 47). We exclude crowns with low overall curvature or significant antagonist intersections, retaining only geometrically complex, well-fitting samples. The crown restorations were designed by dental technicians in routine clinical workflows, reflecting real-world variability in crown quality.
blocks.zh:
外国直接投资16冠数据集 为了推进牙冠生成研究,我们发布了外国直接投资16冠数据集。 数据集包括11 513个匿名内部扫描,通过3个形状牙科系统收集,
并分别进行1 000个扫描以进行验证和测试。 每次扫描都与最终的王冠修复相配. 我们的重点是外国直接投资16个牙齿(右上方第一牙齿),因为它是一种经常被恢复的牙齿,呈现出任何牙齿类型最复杂的隐形形态,有4至5个胸口、斜脊和细细的裂缝图案,使其成为一个具有挑战性的基准。 FDI 16 Toth Dataset [26] 也包含这种牙齿,但只包含孤立的自然牙齿. 我们的数据集提供了与周边凹槽相配的冠修复,使得有条件生成成为可能. 所有扫描都集中在FDI 16冠上,用3Shape Ortho系统2025通过分块清除了gingiva。
如果有的话,扫描包括准备侧相邻的牙齿(FDI 15,17)和对立侧相邻的牙齿(FDI 45,46,47). 我们排除了总体曲率低或有显著对立性相交的花冠,只保留了几何复杂,配相良好的样品. 皇冠修复由牙科技术人员在常规临床工作流程中设计出,在皇冠质量上反映了现实世界的可变性.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the reconstruction fidelity of CrownFusion on the FDI 16 Tooth Dataset [ 26 ] , and the generative quality and diversity of the full pipeline on our FDI 16 Crown Dataset through standard metrics and a proposed measure occlusal fit metric to complement them.
blocks.zh: 我们通过标准衡量尺度和拟议衡量隔离性衡量尺度来评估皇家联合对外国直接投资的忠诚程度、16 " 牙齿数据集 " 、16 " 皇家数据集 " 的全部外国直接投资管道的遗传质量和多样性。

blocks.en:
Autoencoding using geometry images and comparisons .
Since the quality of crown generation via CrownFusion is bounded by the reconstruction fidelity of its autoencoder (AE), we first evaluate our VAE to establish an upper bound on generative performance. In the absence of prior image-based AE baselines for our task, we compare against point cloud-based autoencoders previously benchmarked on the FDI 16 Tooth Dataset [ 26 ] , reporting CD [ 1 ] and Earth mover’s distances (EMDs) [ 16 ] . It is worth noting that these point cloud AE baselines all input and output 2,048 points, while our VAE inputs and outputs geometry images. We convert the output CrownImage into a mesh, project each GT point onto its surface, and compute CD and EMD between the GT and projected point clouds (denoted CrownFusion † \dagger ). This point-to-surface evaluation is more favorable than point-to-point comparison, as the continuous mesh surface naturally reduces distances to arbitrary query points.
blocks.zh:
使用几何图像和比较自动编码 。
由于通过CrownFusion生成王冠的质量以它的自编码器(AE)的再生忠心为界限,我们首先评价我们的VAE,以建立基因性能的上限. 由于没有先前的基于图像的AE基线来完成我们的任务,我们与先前以外国直接投资16 " 牙齿数据集 " 为基准的基于点云的自动编码器进行比较,报告CD [1]和地球移动器的距离[16]。 值得注意的是,这些点云AE基线所有输入和输出2,048分,而我们的VAE输入和输出几何图像. 我们把输出的 CrownImage 转换成网格,将每个 GT 点投影到它的表面,并在 GT 和 预测点云之间计算 CD 和 EMD(注意 CrownFusion \\\dagger ) 。 这种点对地评价比点对点比较更有利,因为连续网状地表自然会将距离缩短到任意的查询点.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that our VAE yields the lowest error, which can be attributed to the significantly higher spatial resolution of the CrownImages and the FLUX architecture. Visual comparison in Fig. 4 shows that our reconstructions preserve geometric detail beyond what the point-based protocol could capture.
blocks.zh: 表1显示我们的VAE产生最小的误差,这可以归因于CrownImages和FLUX架构的空间分辨率显著提高. 图4的可视比较显示,我们的重建保存了几何细节,超出了基于点的协议所能捕捉的范围.

blocks.en:
Static occlusal fit .
Next, we train and evaluate the conditional generative pipeline on FDI 16. We compare against DMC [ 7 ] and VBCD [ 20 ] , the two most recent crown completion-based methods with available implementations ( Table 2 ). We report the Chamfer distance to a dental crown selected by a dental technician, following prior work [ 7 , 23 , 20 ] . Although our generative approach yields higher reconstruction error than the deterministic VBCD, it outperforms DMC, despite modeling a full distribution rather than a single output.
blocks.zh:
静态闭塞适合。
接下来,我们培训和评价关于外国直接投资16的有条件的基因管道。 我们比较了DMC[7]和VBCD[20],这两个最新的冠式完成方法与现有的执行方法(表2)。 我们报告Chamfer与牙医技术员选择的牙冠的距离,这是在前期工作之后[7、23、20]。 虽然我们的基因方法产生的重建错误比确定性的VBCD要高,但它的效绩却超过DMC,尽管模型是完全分布而不是单一输出.

blocks.en:
Relying on a single technician-designed crown as ground truth is problematic, since crown designs vary substantially between technicians, and many retain most of the default library tooth morphology with minor adjustments. Similarity to one such reference therefore says little about the clinical quality of a generated crown [ 13 , 21 ] .
We propose to evaluate occlusal fit by measuring the proximity between the generated occlusal surface and the antagonist dentition. Since teeth rarely align one-to-one, we evaluate occlusal fit against the antagonist tooth and its two nearest neighbors. We sample 30,000 points from these antagonist teeth to enable dense evaluation, and report the mean distance of the closest 10th-percentile of antagonist points to the generated crown surface. This percentile captures the near-contact region most relevant to the occlusal fit.
We also report intersections between the generated crown and antagonist surfaces, both count and area, as occlusal intersections require significant manual sculpting to correct, unlike proximal intersections which occur on smoother, more accessible surfaces. Minimizing these intersections is therefore essential for reducing manual intervention in clinical workflows.
blocks.zh:
依靠单个技术员设计的花冠,因为地面真理是成问题的,因为花冠的设计在技术员之间差别很大,许多人保留了大部分默认的图书牙齿形态,略作调整. 因此,与这种提法相似之处是,对所生成的冠的临床质量几乎没有任何说明。
我们建议通过测量所生成的封口地表与对立凹陷之间的相近性来评估封口是否合适. 由于牙齿很少与一对一对齐,所以我们评价与对立口牙齿及其两个相近的邻居相匹配的闭合性. 我们从这些对角牙齿中抽取出3万分,以便进行密集评价,并报告最接近对角牙齿的第10分点与所生成的王冠表面的平均距离. 这种百分位法能捕捉到与闭合体最相近的接触区域.
我们还报告生成的王冠和对立面之间的相接点,包括计数和面积,因为闭塞相接点需要大量的人工雕刻来纠正,这与较平滑,更方便取道的相接点不同. 因此,尽量减少这些交叉点对于减少临床工作流程的人工干预至关重要。

blocks.en: Table 2: Comparison of CrownFusion against previous methods for dental crown design. Crown similarity is measured by Chamfer Distance (CD-L2, mm) to a dental technician selected crown. Occlusal fit is evaluated against the three nearest antagonist teeth (by mean distance of 10th-percentile closest points) and surface intersections (count out of 1,000 sampled points, and area in mm 2 ). CrownFusion achieves the best occlusal fit with fewer intersections and competitive antagonist proximity.

blocks.en:
CrownFusion achieves the closest occlusal alignment to the antagonist teeth ( Table 2 ), with fewer intersections than both baselines and roughly half the intersection rate of DMC. When intersections do occur, their area is substantially smaller than in prior methods. Figure 5 shows a representative example.
Ground truth crowns exhibit minimal intersections (12/1000, 0.0437 mm 2 ), indicating room for future improvement.
blocks.zh:
CrownFusion实现了与对角齿最接近的闭合(表2),相交点比两个基线都少,大约是DMC相交点率的一半. 当交叉发生时,它们的面积大大小于以前的方法。 图5是一个有代表性的例子。
地面真理花冠显示有最小的相交点(12/1000,0.0437 mm 2 ),表明未来改进的空间.

blocks.en:
Expert evaluation .
To complement quantitative metrics, we consulted two dental professionals who assessed generated crowns across all methods. They noted that CrownFusion produces well-defined occlusal anatomy, rarely generating the featureless surfaces typical of DMC’s overly smooth crowns with shallow fissures and blunt cusps. Across DMC, VBCD, and even the reference crowns, fissures occasionally appear as isolated incisions without corresponding cusp development, yielding anatomically incoherent surfaces; CrownFusion was less prone to this. It does, however, occasionally produce flattened proximal surfaces that conform too closely to adjacent teeth rather than forming convex contacts, likely reflecting training data where technicians rely on automated fitting tools. This, with occlusal anatomy that does not always match the clinical context, points to conditioning and data curation as areas for improvement.
blocks.zh:
专家评价.
为了补充量化标准,我们咨询了两名牙科专业人员,他们评估了各种方法产生的冠冕。 他们指出,王冠融合产生了定义明确的隐形解剖学,很少产生DMC所特有的有浅裂和钝裂的花冠过于平滑的地表. 纵观DMC,VBCD,甚至参考冠等,裂口偶尔会作为孤立的切口出现,没有相应的裂口发育,产生解剖学上不相通的表面; CrownFusion不太容易发生这种情况. 不过,它偶尔会产生过于接近相邻牙齿的平地相近表面,而不是形成对流接触,可能反映技术员依赖自动装配工具的培训数据。 以并不总是与临床环境相匹配的闭塞解剖学为例,将条件和数据解剖视为需要改进的领域。

blocks.en:
Morphological variation across samples .
Finally, we examine whether the variation across samples generated for the same patient aligns with the design freedom available in clinical practice. While marginal ridge height and gross cusp placement are constrained by the surrounding dentition, the occlusal surface is the primary locus of design freedom [ 21 ] , with cusp height, fissure depth, and secondary ridge anatomy varying substantially between technicians.
blocks.zh:
不同样本的形态变化
最后,我们审查为同一病人生成的样本的变异是否与临床实践中可用的设计自由相符合。 虽然边缘山脊高地和毛脊布置受到周围凹陷的制约,但隐蔽地表是设计自由的主要地壳[21],而山脊高地,裂缝深度,以及次级山脊解剖学在技术人员之间差别很大.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 shows how the model varies fissure pattern detail, secondary fossae, distolingual cusp, and oblique ridge morphology across samples, consistent with these features carrying more design freedom. Marginal ridge height and overall crown outline remain largely stable, though in isolated cases the variation is larger than clinically ideal. Notably, the features that vary are those most difficult to sculpt manually, as existing CAD tools primarily support local adjustments rather than global morphological changes. Extending the model to offer controllable gross shape diversity through explicit conditioning is a natural next step.

blocks.en: Limitations . Our evaluation focuses on FDI 16; generalization across all tooth types remains to be validated, though the strong generalization of latent diffusion in image synthesis is encouraging. The disk topology of geometry images currently restricts the framework to single-tooth restoration, and conditioning on absent neighbouring teeth is not yet addressed. Generation time ( ∼ \sim 5 min per 8 samples on an RTX 4090) is a practical constraint, though the extensive literature on diffusion sampling acceleration transfers directly to our setting.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented CrownFusion , the first latent diffusion model for 3D dental crown generation using an image-based teeth representation, CrownImage . CrownFusion generates diverse, well-formed crowns with improved handling of high-curvature dental features, competitive occlusal fit, and fewer antagonist intersections. We release an accompanying dataset of 11,513 annotated intraoral scans and propose an occlusal fit metric based on antagonist proximity.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CrownFusion, 这是第一个潜在的扩散模型 3D牙科花冠生成 使用基于图像的牙齿 代表,CrownImage。 CrownFusion产生多样,造型良好的花冠,改进了对高曲率牙齿特征的处理,具有竞争性的闭塞相合性,并减少了对立相交. 我们发布了11 513个附带注释的内侧扫描数据集,并根据对立方的相邻性提出一个闭合度量度.
